Ava (Growth): finalizing the social schedule for the 'Inference Unlocked' webinar — want to do a staggered twilight surge so NA morning + APAC evening get coverage. need final copy + assets by EOD. @Diego @Samira can you take? :calendar:
Diego (Content): on it — i'll do 3 copy variants (headline A/B + short replies). which hero image should we use, static or GIF?
Samira (Creative): hero + a 6s GIF would be best for X. uploading assets now to drive → https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/inference-assets :arrow_up:
Jordan (Product Marketing): SDR routing question — who owns inbound tickets from X replies? @Riley are you ok to take live routing?
Riley (SDR): yep i'll own routing. plan: tag leads with webinar=inf-apr and source=xlnk, forward hot leads to #sdr-live via webhook https://hooks.redwood.ai/sdr. If same account replies >3x mark as HOT.
Ava (Growth): engagement follows — let's prepare 3 starter replies to drop in thread: (1) thanks + register CTA, (2) stat-led hook + register, (3) offer demo / PM. @Diego can you draft those so SDRs have examples? :memo:
Diego (Content): draft replies: "Thanks! Save your seat → https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_campaign=inf-apr"; "Quick stat: 3x lower per-token cost in production — register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"; "Want a demo? DM us or book: https://redwood.ai/demo". Will shorten variants for X.
Samira (Creative): posting cadence proposal: X posts staggered at 8:00 PT, 11:00 ET, 17:00 SGT (same creative, different captions); LinkedIn post at 11:00 PT (carousel with 2 links). MarketingBot scheduled preview: https://app.redwood.ai/scheduler/preview/1738001234
Jordan (Product Marketing): benchmark narrative for the thread — emphasize latency wins + cost per token improvements and a brief customer example. dropping a 1-pager here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/bench/inference-webinar
Ava (Growth): can we A/B headline on X? Variant A: "Inference Unlocked: Faster, Cheaper LLM serving" Variant B: "Ship LLM features with predictable cost & latency" — Diego please pick primary and set up 50/50 test.
Diego (Content): will A/B with analytics tag ab_headline=webinar_inf and track CTR + register rate. primary will be A unless copy proves weak.
Riley (SDR): routing note — mapping set. Also if we get >10 engagements from an org within 24h, escalate to AE queue. I'll add mapping doc to confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sales/webinar-routing
Samira (Creative): assets uploaded: hero_3.jpg, hero_gif_6s.mp4, carousel_slide1.png, carousel_slide2.png — link above. also including alt copy for accessibility.
Ava (Growth): quick checklist / action items: Diego — copy + variants (due 2pm PT); Samira — final assets upload (done by 12pm PT); Riley — SDR routing + webhook verified (EOD); Jordan — bench 1-pager + suggested bullets (EOD). we'll review in 3pm sync. :thumbsup: 
MarketingBot: post scheduled (staggered) for 1738041600 / 1738056000 / 1738099200, preview link: https://app.redwood.ai/scheduler/preview/1738001234
Diego (Content): noted. will post copy in the thread once finalized for quick QA.
Ava (Growth): thanks team — let's keep replies snappy in-thread so SDR handoff is clean. if anyone needs to swap tasks ping me. :sparkles:
